name: service-slots
body: Keys are user-supplied. No shipped keys. A pod arrives pre-wired to a service with a link to go get a key. The stable name in code is the service slot; vendors plug in. Named plugs: OpenRouter primary, Gemini and OpenAI as alternatives. weave/ still does not print vendor names. Keys live in the token store, not in the bot file. Status is green only after a live call returns clean. Validate-on-use. Coin-slot as the empty-key mark is an aside, not a ruling.
waitingOn: Owner Check. Gear-as-chrome is superseded by this only after Check.
